title: Partners determined by the pairing trace
statement: Let $r,k\in\mathbb{N}$ with $r>0$, and let $R$ be a set of vertices in the complete $2r$-partite graph with $|R|=2s$. Suppose two perfect matchings each send every vertex of $R$ to its partner within $R$, and their greedy pairing traces on $R$ agree. Then the two matchings assign the same partner to every vertex of $R$.
hypotheses_covered: a remaining vertex set of cardinality 2s
each matching sends every vertex of the remaining set to a partner in that set
the two greedy pairing traces on that set agree
